    Prompts

    Rules history

    Every save of the team standard keeps the old version here. Load one to put it back in the editor, then save it as the team standard to bring it back.

    Loading history…

    Component map

    One line per rule: match => layout. A match is a C-number (C36) or words from the component name (Tile Group); separate alternatives with |. The first line that matches wins. Anything unmatched shows as an outlined “Unmapped” block and is listed in Issues.

    Character limits

    Limits are read from each slot's label in the copy doc, like ~45 ch or 60–65 ch hard truncation. For a range, the top number is the limit.

    Placeholders

    How copy-cell values that aren't real copy are shown. One per line: starts with => hide | todo | missing. hide leaves the slot off the page, todo shows a gray “to do in AEM” chip, missing shows a red chip and adds an issue.

    Devices

    Mobile text styles switch on below 768 px, the same breakpoint as the Figma Mobile frames.

    Images

    Sample photos are stand-ins until the real images are added in AEM. Turn this off to show plain gray placeholders instead.

    Tile and drawer colors

    The square tiles in Tile Group w/ Image take these colors in order (tile 1 yellow, tile 2 green, and so on), and each tile's drawer opens in the same color. Other drawers rotate through the list. Options: yellow green sky magenta gray navy orange.
